_comment: The one place repo, board and people are named. Filled by .claude/scripts/setup-github.py; edit by hand for people and areas. Scripts and hooks read this, nothing is hard-coded. A repo spawned from the template inherits these values and setup-github.py resets them on first run, because ids from another repo's board are not yours.

wait_guard.way_out: Cloud runs and test gates: add --detach (blender_cloud.py, tools/usd/settle.py, tools/review/page.py) or wrap them in tools/cloud/detached.py, which prints one result line at the end.

purge._comment: Where /purge (.claude/skills/purge) finds this repository's test bookkeeping: each value a command run at a worktree root, or an instruction where there is no command.
purge.suite: make tests (the test rule's guard first, then every test file in its sandbox at TEST_SECONDS)
purge.test_debt: python3 tools/test_rule/check.py, read beside its FUNCTION_DEBT, ALLOWLIST and MAIN_ONLY entries
purge.test_new: one test_<invariant>.py in the module's directory, holding one test function, its docstring naming the break that turns it red (applied once, seen red, reverted); bible workflow/module-standard
purge.time_budget: TEST_SECONDS a file (Makefile, the one constant make tests reads); the whole suite within the time root CLAUDE.md sets
purge.modules: the directory a test file sits in, a tests/ folder counting as its parent's, and in FLAT_TOOL_FOLDERS each tool script (tools/test_rule/check.py)
